name: instance-editor
description: A reflective editor for model instances - both static (generated code) and dynamic (loaded .ecore, not generated) modes, populated at runtime from whatever the root instance's own EClass actually is. Bundles the shared TypeMF runtime (package/resource-factory/URI-converter registries) directly - no longer a separate extension (see the two-section 'configuration' below: this is one single installed extension, with its own Editor and Runtime settings grouped under it).

typemf.showDerivedFeatures.description: Show derived EStructuralFeatures (computed, not independently stored) in the properties panel. Off by default, since a derived feature is read-only and usually just clutter.

nsURI.description: The EPackage nsURI this mapping registers.

ecoreFile.description: Path to the .ecore file, resolved relative to the first workspace folder.

typemf.ecoreMappings.description: Maps a metamodel's nsURI to a .ecore file, loaded and registered into the shared package registry at startup. Merged across user/workspace/workspace-folder settings, most specific wins per nsURI (workspace-folder, then workspace, then user).
